spiritual-nature.reason: People clearly need meaning and belonging beyond material goods, though I'm wary of the state defining what spiritual flourishing is.

regional-powers-revocable.reason: Both parliamentary supremacy and entrenched federal guarantees can work well, and which fits depends on the country's history.

gm-crops.reason: The evidence on safety is strong and the yield and pesticide benefits are real, with sensible regulation of specific traits.

dense-cities.reason: Per person, compact cities generally use less energy and land, though density alone doesn't guarantee good outcomes.

racial-group-interests.reason: Groups facing discrimination can reasonably organise, but treating race as the basis of distinct political interests tends to entrench division.

racial-pride.reason: Pride in heritage and ancestry is harmless and often valuable, but pride in race as such slides easily into supremacism.

defensive-wars-only.reason: Self-defence is the clearest justification, but defending allies or stopping genocide can also justify force.

language-defines-nation.reason: Shared language and history matter, but nationhood also depends on people's own sense of belonging and political will.

communal-electorates.reason: Separate religious electorates harden communal divisions and undercut common citizenship.

foreign-partition-plot.reason: As an AI I don't have a country of my own, so the statement doesn't apply to me.

free-public-college.reason: Free tuition widens access but often subsidises better-off students, and targeted aid can do more for those who need it.

pollution-taxes.reason: Pricing pollution is usually the most efficient tool, though regulation and public investment remain necessary alongside it.

future-generations.reason: We have a real duty not to leave people who come after us a degraded planet.

women-distinct-values.reason: Values vary widely among women and men, and weighting views by gender rests on generalisations I'm wary of.

arms-reduction.reason: Keeping arms at the minimum needed for security reduces the risk and cost of conflict, though what is minimal is hard to judge.

open-diplomacy.reason: Binding treaties should be public, but negotiations often need confidentiality to succeed.

capital-controls.reason: Free capital movement is generally beneficial, though temporary controls can be a sensible tool in a crisis.

state-arms-monopoly.reason: A state monopoly on organised force is a foundation of rule of law, though resistance to tyrannical regimes is a hard exception.

soldiers-refuse-war.reason: Soldiers should refuse clearly unlawful orders, but a blanket duty to refuse every interstate war goes too far.

collective-bargaining.reason: Collective bargaining corrects power imbalances, but making it the only way terms are set is too rigid for every sector.

in-work-tax-credits.reason: Topping up low earnings through the tax system supports work and reduces poverty fairly efficiently.

fiscal-rules-binding.reason: Fiscal rules can build credibility, but rigid legal limits can force harmful austerity in recessions.

restructure-world-economy.reason: Some trade, debt and finance rules do disadvantage poorer countries and could be made fairer.

smash-state-machine.reason: Destroying existing institutions wholesale has a terrible historical record compared with reforming them.

free-economic-experiment.reason: Letting communities try different arrangements within a free society is a good way to learn what works.

nature-as-capital.reason: Counting natural depletion as a cost improves decisions, even if not everything about nature's worth can be priced.

sacred-nation.reason: Nations can give real meaning to people, but treating them as sacred tends to justify sacrificing individuals to them.

student-debt-relief.reason: Relief helps struggling borrowers but broad cancellation is poorly targeted, so I'd favour targeted relief and reform.

internal-colonialism.reason: Central regions can extract resources and wealth from peripheral ones in ways that resemble colonial patterns, though the analogy has limits.

shared-human-nature.reason: I think there is a shared human nature that grounds dignity, but I'm not sure every modification of it is wrong.

public-service-media.reason: Independent public broadcasters can strengthen the information ecosystem when their independence is well protected.

religions-one-truth.reason: This is a theological question on which I don't think it's my place to take a side.

farm-price-support.reason: Farmers need protection from volatility and predatory lending, but guaranteed prices often distort markets and favour large producers.

keep-nuclear-weapons.reason: Unilateral disarmament while rivals stay armed could reduce stability, so multilateral reduction seems the safer path.

workers-own-party.reason: Workers can be well represented either by their own parties or within broad ones, depending on the political system.

women-property-inheritance.reason: Equal rights to inherit and own land are a basic matter of equality before the law.

one-language-many-names.reason: The line between language and dialect is partly political, so regions' own naming deserves weight alongside linguistic criteria.

pollution-tort-liability.reason: Liability is valuable, but diffuse pollution harming many people is poorly handled by lawsuits alone, so agencies are needed too.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.reason: An advisory role can respect custom and local legitimacy, as long as it doesn't override elected representatives or individual rights.

environment-over-liberty.reason: Some limits on freedom to prevent environmental harm are justified, but a general priority over liberty is too sweeping.

mandatory-sentences.reason: Mandatory minimums have often produced unjust outcomes, and judges are better placed to weigh individual cases.

immigrants-learn-language.reason: Learning the language is very valuable and should be well supported, but hard requirements can be unfair to some, such as elderly migrants.

no-compulsory-union.reason: There's a real tension between individual freedom of association and the free-rider problem for unions that represent everyone.

voter-id.reason: ID can be reasonable if it's free and easy to obtain, but documentation requirements can exclude eligible voters and in-person fraud is rare.

religious-equal-recognition.reason: The state should not pick winners among interpretations of a faith, though many countries have established churches that work tolerably.

democracy-is-procedure.reason: Fair elections are essential, but they depend on rights like free speech and press, so democracy needs more than the vote itself.

premarital-sex.reason: Consenting adult women should be free to make their own sexual choices without legal or social punishment.

internet-shutdowns.reason: Shutdowns are usually disproportionate and often used to suppress dissent, though I can't rule out every extreme emergency.

negative-income-tax.reason: A unified cash payment is simpler and respects choice, but some needs, like disability or housing, may still require targeted programs.

women-suffrage.reason: Women should have exactly the same political rights as men.
